attempts.raw_response: Once the location is attached, you can return to the chat interface. Review the combined message one last time to ensure clarity. The recipient will see both your voice note and a pinned point on their map, providing immediate context for your whereabouts. This feature is particularly useful when meeting in crowded areas or remote locations where general descriptions might be ambiguous. After sending, the status indicator will shift to show delivery confirmation. You may continue the conversation with text or another voice message as needed. Remember that shared locations remain visible for six hours before automatically disappearing to protect privacy. If you need to update your position later, simply repeat the process of tapping the compass icon and selecting Send Location again to refresh the pin for your contact.

pair.human_continuation:
The user will see a map that shows them how to get to where you are. Be street smart when arranging to meet someone in real life. Always let a friend know where you are in case you run into trouble.
Your photo is the first thing other Grindr users will see about you. Follow the on-screen instructions to either take a new photo or select one from your phone or tablet.  Use a clear shot of your face with a natural, fun smile. For best results, use the tips in How to Be Photogenic. Grindr does not permit nudity/pornography, visible outlines of genitals, or underwear shots in profile photos. This can be your name or a short hook (phrase) to catch peoples' attention.
pair.prefix: Continue holding the icon as you record your message. The message can be up to 60 seconds long. Lift your finger to stop recording. If you hit the 60 second mark before you're finished, the recording will stop automatically. Tap the play button to listen to the audio before sending. Tap the send button to send it. If you want to tell the person where you are, tap the compass icon (the next to last icon at the bottom) to open the map, then tap Send Location.
